cone_contract.conformal_photon_cone: For tilde_g=A^2*g, tilde_g^mu_nu*k_mu*k_nu=A^-2*g^mu_nu*k_mu*k_nu; positive finite A leaves the photon null cone identical to the Einstein tensor cone, so the local structural ratio is c_GW/c_gamma=1.
cone_contract.disformal_necessary_interval: With delta_G=1/1000000000000000, |Delta^(-1/2)-1|<=delta_G is equivalent to 1-(1-delta_G)^(-2)<=q<=1-(1+delta_G)^(-2), in addition to Delta>0.
cone_contract.einstein_tensor_cone: Because the committed gravitational curvature term is Einstein-Hilbert and the scalar terms contain no curvature coupling, the tensor principal cone is g^mu_nu*k_mu*k_nu=0 on the declared background, subject to the still-unproved full constrained-system health.
cone_contract.homogeneous_disformal_cones: Lorentzian signature requires Delta>0; c_gamma=sqrt(Delta), c_GW=1, and c_GW/c_gamma=Delta^(-1/2).
cone_contract.homogeneous_disformal_metric: For tilde_g=A^2*[g+d_phi*d(phi)*d(phi)/M_phi^4] and local g=diag(-1,1,1,1) with phi=phi(t), define q=d_phi*dot(phi)^2/M_phi^4=2*d_phi*X_phi/M_phi^4 and Delta=1-q. Then tilde_g=A^2*diag(-Delta,1,1,1).
cone_contract.not_claimed: Exact restricted cone algebra is not an observational GW-speed pass, a preferred-frame pass, a hyperbolicity proof, or a viable disformal lensing completion.
cone_contract.static_radial_disformal_cones: Radial photons have c_gamma,r=(1+s)^(-1/2), while Einstein tensor waves have c_GW,r=1, so c_GW,r/c_gamma,r=sqrt(1+s). Tangential photon speed is unchanged in this local frame. This anisotropy prevents importing the conformal one-parameter PPN derivation.
cone_contract.static_radial_disformal_metric: For a prescribed radial gradient in a local orthonormal frame, s=d_phi*(partial_r phi)^2/M_phi^4 and tilde_g=A^2*diag(-1,1+s,1,1); Lorentzian signature requires 1+s>0.

conformal_solar_contract.canonical_coupling_subcase: For one unscreened massless scalar with canonical coefficient kappa>0 and alpha=M_Pl*partial_varphi ln A constant, epsilon=2*alpha^2/kappa. The inherited Solar threshold then necessarily requires alpha^2/kappa<=delta_S/[2*(2-delta_S)]=23/3999954. This normalization is explicitly tied to L=-kappa*(partial varphi)^2/2 and M_Pl^-2=8*pi*G_*.
conformal_solar_contract.fifth_force_definition: epsilon=F_5/F_E=(partial_r a)/(partial_r Phi_E) on the common 1/r attractive branch; the total slow-body force is F_E*(1+epsilon).
conformal_solar_contract.high_acceleration_implication: With Z=(1+u)^2, m_eff=m_chi*(1+u)/sqrt(Y0), so epsilon_chi(r)->0 as u->infinity at every fixed r>0 in the restricted constant-coefficient point-source subcase. This does not screen the phi conformal force and does not establish that a physical Solar source realizes constant u or the frozen source law.
conformal_solar_contract.lensing_implication: The conformal scalar cancels from Phi+Psi at this linear bookkeeping order. The same epsilon that strengthens slow-body attraction produces slip; it cannot be reassigned to photons with an independent multiplier.
conformal_solar_contract.linear_physical_potentials: Writing a=delta ln A, Phi=Phi_E+a and Psi=Psi_E-a. For Phi_E=Psi_E=-U and a=-epsilon*U, Phi=-(1+epsilon)U and Psi=-(1-epsilon)U.
conformal_solar_contract.matter_variation_derivation: At fixed g, delta(tilde_g_mu_nu)=2*tilde_g_mu_nu*delta(ln A), so delta S_m=(1/2)*integral sqrt(-tilde_g)*tilde_T^mu_nu*delta(tilde_g_mu_nu)=integral sqrt(-g)*T_E*delta(ln A). Therefore Q_a=-(1/sqrt(-g))*delta S_m/delta(varphi_a)=-(partial_a ln A)*T_E; for nonrelativistic matter T_E approximately -rho_E, giving Q_a approximately +(alpha_a/M_Pl)*rho_E. This derives the trace source functional from the universal metric but does not supply a finite Solar density profile or an on-shell solution.

a finite material trace profile and the backreacted Q_phi and Q_chi on a solved Solar source
a regular finite-radius Sun solution and exterior matching
the nonlinear P branch, boundary conditions, metric backreaction, beta_PPN, or preferred-frame parameters
a Cassini time-delay prediction or likelihood
conformal_solar_contract.ppn_derivation: gamma_PPN=Psi/Phi=(1-epsilon)/(1+epsilon), hence gamma_PPN-1=-2*epsilon/(1+epsilon). This follows from the universal conformal metric and the frozen 1/r ansatz; it is not an assumed PPN formula for arbitrary profiles.
conformal_solar_contract.split_chi_yukawa_subcase: For constant Y0,Z and Q_chi=alpha_chi*rho/M_Pl, m_eff=m_chi*sqrt(Z/Y0), chi=-alpha_chi*M*exp(-m_eff*r)/(4*pi*Y0*M_Pl*r), and epsilon_chi(r)=2*alpha_chi^2*(1+m_eff*r)*exp(-m_eff*r)/Y0.
conformal_solar_contract.universal_metric: tilde_g_mu_nu=A(phi,chi)^2*g_mu_nu for every massive and massless species, with A positive and finite.

frozen_background_scope.forbidden_inference: No Solar, cosmological, galaxy, cluster, lensing, or gravitational-wave source/background solution is inferred from these frozen subcases.
frozen_background_scope.gw: Local inertial patch on a prescribed homogeneous timelike phi background for the time-disformal cone, plus a separate prescribed static radial phi gradient for the spatial-disformal cone. Neither background is asserted to solve the field equations.
frozen_background_scope.ppn_subcase: Only when a=-epsilon*U with constant epsilon over the relevant exterior interval do the potentials have the standard common 1/r PPN form. A Yukawa or nonlinear screened profile requires a direct radius-dependent observable calculation and is not assigned one global gamma_PPN here.
frozen_background_scope.solar: Weak-field static spherical exterior bookkeeping with g_00=-(1+2*Phi_E), g_ij=(1-2*Psi_E)delta_ij, Phi_E=Psi_E=-U, U=G_*M/r>0, |U|<<1, and a=delta ln A. This is a conditional local ansatz, not an on-shell solution of the split-gate action.
frozen_background_scope.source_subcase: The illustrative chi response additionally assumes constant Y0 and Z, linear A with alpha_chi=M_Pl*partial_chi ln A, a pointlike nonrelativistic source, frozen delta_phi, negligible scalar stress at linear metric order, and the decaying R3 solution.

limitations: The PPN relation is exact only within the frozen weak-field common-1/r conformal subcase; Yukawa and nonlinear profiles require direct predictions.
The point-source Yukawa force ratio is a restricted constant-coefficient illustration, not the missing physical source/background solution.
Conformal cone alignment is structural and local; it is not an empirical GW-speed pass or proof of the full constrained system.
The disformal inequalities are necessary cone conditions on prescribed backgrounds, not proof that either background exists dynamically.
No observational data, likelihood, fit, Solar/GW pass, lensing result, novelty result, or publication claim is produced.
remaining_blockers: Freeze A(phi,chi), P(X), V(phi), parameters, branch, cutoff, and boundary conditions without Solar-only coefficients.
Derive Q_phi and Q_chi by varying the same universal matter action for a finite material source; do not insert rho by hand.
Solve and match a regular static spherical Sun/interior/exterior scalar-metric background, retaining nonconstant coefficients and active phi-chi mixing.
Derive the full weak-field metric and direct light-time, orbital, beta_PPN, preferred-frame, and disformal observables from that one solution.
Solve an on-shell late-time cosmological background and the full constrained tensor-scalar-matter characteristic system.
For a nonzero disformal branch, satisfy the exact frozen q interval everywhere relevant and establish invertibility, hyperbolicity, and EFT control.
Only after all theory inputs and adjudicators are frozen may separately authorized observational rows be opened; this package opens none.

checks.statement: The universal conformal factor adds a to the temporal potential.
The same factor subtracts a from the spatial potential.
The common 1/r subcase fixes gamma_PPN rather than assuming it.
The PPN deviation is the exact conformal fifth-force relation.
The signed repulsive endpoint saturates the inherited absolute gamma ceiling.
The attractive endpoint saturates the inherited absolute gamma ceiling.
A canonical scalar contributes epsilon=2 alpha^2/kappa.
The decaying Yukawa profile solves the exterior homogeneous equation for r>0.
The restricted point-source force ratio includes the Yukawa derivative factor.
The split mass gate suppresses the restricted chi force at fixed positive r.
On a g-null covector, the conformal inverse-metric null form also vanishes.
The homogeneous disformal photon speed squared is Delta=1-q.
Einstein tensor waves and disformal photons have ratio Delta^-1/2.
The squared speed ratios at the exact q endpoints are (1-delta_G)^2 and (1+delta_G)^2.
A radial disformal gradient separates the radial photon and tensor cones.
Varying one universal conformal metric gives Q_a=-(partial_a ln A)*T_E.
